api-foundations.copy: Icon Button API stays compact: one icon, one accessible action name, one shared action-family emphasis variant, Density-owned scale, and explicit selected state only when the action is a toggle.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Visual emphasis shared with Button. ZIP tonal maps to secondary; ZIP accent is not a separate Flow variant.

props.name: intent
props.notes: Semantic action intent shared with Button.

props.name: density
props.notes: Design System Density context for the fixed circular hit area.

props.name: loading
props.notes: Shows Spinner, exposes aria-busy, and blocks duplicate activation.
